gloss: be cornered, thrust into a corner, or aside
definition: [ כָּנַף ] verb denominative from כָּנָף 2. only Niph`al be cornered, thrust into a corner, or aside ; — Imperfect 3 masculine singular וְלֹא יִכָּנֵף עוֺד מוֺרֶי֔ךָ Isa 30:20 and no more shall thy teachers be thrust into a corner (compare Di ); > others, who render hide themselves , (compare Arabic enclose, guard , but this rather for protection).

[כָּנַף] verb denominative from כָּנָף

2. only Niph`al be cornered, thrust into a corner, or aside; — Imperfect 3 masculine singular וְלֹא יִכָּנֵף עוֺד מוֺרֶי֔ךָ Isa 30:20 and no more shall thy teachers be thrust into a corner (compare Di); > others, who render hide themselves, (compare Arabic enclose, guard, but this rather for protection).
